افصل المحرك الكهربائي وجهاز الحظر عن المروحة.

Remove all the auxiliary equipments installed on the bearings pyrometric 
 probes
Discharge the bearings from their oil
Break away the shaft tight from the inlet boxes.
Disconnect the shaped inlets from the casing.

Remove the upper part of the fan casing which allows the dismantling of the 
 rotor.

sling the rotor 
ملاحظة: normally all the bearing compounds are marked in order to 
 avoid any mistake during the reassembly

Unscrew the tow side parts of each bearing taking care not to damage the 
 gaskets.
Remove the upper part of each bearing taking care not to damage the gaskets.
Sling up the rotor and put it down on the maintenance area.

ملاحظة: we advise to put the 
 rotor on wooden made supports in order to avoid to damage the shaft or the 
 impeller.

Remove the half coupling on the motor side and the free wheel on the barring 
 device side.
Remove the central bolt of each bearing
Slide the outer side of each bearing to the shaft tip
Slide the outer spacers to the shaft tips
To remove the bearing try to use a hub puller

Install the rolling bearings on the shaft as indicated here under, the rolling bearings are installed tightened on the shaft 
 .

تأكد من أن المحامل المتداول لا تحتوي على مواد غريبة. في هذه الحالة، نظيفة 
 لهم بالروح أو البنزين.

Heat the rolling bearing in an oil bath at a temperature of 100 to120
 C 
 without exceeding 120
 C

Check that the oil rings are well installed on the outer spacers stayed in 
 place.
Slid the rolling bearing on the shaft and lock them against the inner spacers.

Assemble the outer spacers and the outer sides of the bearing housing taking 
 care of the guide mark of the different parts and without forgetting the 
 gaskets.
قم بربط البراغي المركزية ثم قم بفراملها باستخدام غسالات الفرامل.
Sling up the rotor and install it on its place on the casing
Assemble the upper parts of bearing housings
Fix the sides of the bearing housings.

Assemble the remaining parts of the fan in the reverse order of the 
 disassembly
